title: Speed Demon
tagline: Stage it, launch it, row the gate clean.
description: A top-down racer built around manual-shift execution. Work an H-pattern gate as real geometry, read the christmas tree for a holeshot, and hold the needle in the window every shift. Distance Race, Time Attack, Rival Race against ten CPU drivers or your own ghost, three-lap Circuit Race, a street-racing campaign, and casual Online Versus. Paint any of 24 cars yourself, chase seven leaderboards, and play your own music folder through the car stereo.
status: Playable — drag + circuit racing, campaign chapter one, vs CPU and ghosts, casual online, customizable garage
